name: Framework help
description: Help mode entries for everything the framework draws in every app: the menu bar, Help mode itself, the standard menus and actions, banners, windows, the terminal, Settings and the words every screen uses (Refresh, Save, Delete…). Written by hand for Brett: short, plain, a little attitude.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Help mode
entries.text: Turns Help mode on or off. On: every button, menu, switch and tab explains itself — hover it, or on a phone tap its little ? (or long-press it). Off: no tooltips, no clutter.
entries.more: Help mode is remembered on this device only, so your phone and your desktop can differ. The first time you open a screen with Help mode on you get a short intro of its main parts; you can skip it, or turn intros off for good. Tooltips never stop a control working: tap the control itself and it does its normal thing.
entries.tryIt: Press F1 anywhere to flip it.

entries.title: Help mode
entries.text: The same switch as the ? at the top: tooltips on everything while it's on, nothing while it's off. Remembered on this device.

steps.say: Every setting lives here, split into tabs: Appearance, Account, Connections, Plugins and About.
The level bar at the top picks how much you see: Simple hides the nerdy stuff, Administrator shows it all.
Help mode has its own switch under About — or just hit F1 anywhere.
Everything you see is an asset: themes, layouts, menus, buttons. Pick one on the left to look at it.
Activate swaps it in live. Nothing reloads, nothing is lost.
Your role decides what you can do. Switch it here to see the app as someone else would.
The buttons below test each permission for the role you picked.
